statement: HPE raised its FY26 revenue growth outlook range to 34% to 37% and its FY27 revenue growth outlook range to 13% to 17%.
why: Raising guidance for both the current and the following year is management saying the AI order book is firm enough to underwrite it.

impact.mechanism: An upward guidance revision at a major AI server OEM implies higher planned accelerator and system purchases across the coming year.

evidence.source: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. (SEC EDGAR 8-K Exhibit 99.1)
evidence.excerpt: HPE is raising its FY26 revenue growth outlook range to 34% to 37%

confidence.basis: Guidance quoted verbatim from the filed 8-K Exhibit 99.1; expressed as growth percentages, so no dollar level is recorded.

dispersion: FY26 growth 34%-37%; FY27 growth 13%-17% - a sharp deceleration in the outer year.
